description_en: Creates a database account for a specified ApsaraDB for ClickHouse cluster
description_zh: 调用CreateAccount接口为指定云数据库ClickHouse集群创建数据库账号
name: CreateAccount

parameters.help_en:
The database account name.
The name must be unique.
It can contain lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_).
It must start with a lowercase letter and end with a lowercase letter or digit.
It must be 2 to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号。
名称唯一。
由小写字母、数字或下划线组成。
以小写字母开头，以小写字母或数字结尾。
长度为2~64个字符
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en:
The password of the database account.
The password must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.
Special characters include !@#$%^&*()_+-=
It must be 8 to 32 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号的密码。
由大写字母、小写字母、数字、特殊字符中的任意三种组成。
特殊字符为!@#$%^&*()_+-=
长度为8~32个字符
parameters.name: account_password

parameters.help_en:
The description of the database account.
It cannot start with http:// or https://.
It must be 0 to 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号的描述。
不能以http://或https://开头。
长度为0~256个字符
parameters.name: account_description
